paite: Akum kuana, akha sawmna, huai kha, ani sawm ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
heading: Sa Uina Bel

paite: "Mihing tapa, tuni ngei, hiai ni min ngei gelhkhia in. Hiai ni ngei in Babulon kumpipa'n Jerusalem ahong sual pan hi.
Huan helhat Inkote kiang ah gentehna thu gen inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
"Sa uina bel suang inla, suang nilouh inla, asung ah tui sung in; sabakte kha inla, asa hoih tengteng, apheite, aliangte, aguhbawk hoih tata in hihdim in.
Ganhonte lak a ahoih tata la inla, anuai ah singkhuah khul ek inla, sou bolhbolh hen; ahi, aguhbomte ki-ui hen."
Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sisan suah hat khopi, sa uina bel, asung kanggem, agem dai ngei nai lou tung agik hi! Tel tuan lou in, asa bak khatkhat in thuk in.
Asisan suah amah tung ah a-om a, leivui vuhtheihna dia lei a sunbuak gen tak louh, suangpi keu tung ah asungbo zawta hi.
Phu la ding a hehna ahong kisaktheihna ding in vuh louh in asisan suah suangpi keu tung ah ka sung ahi."
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sisan suah hat khopi tung agik hi! Kei mahmah in ka vum venvon ding.
Singtum sevum venvon unla, mei chihsa unla, sate ui min unla, satui chiktak in, aguhte leng kangmang hen.
Huchi in bel avuak in meivu tung ah suan hi nilouh henla, ahong sa ding a, adal ahong am ding a, anitna ahong zulmang ding, akangkhem akatmang theihna ding in.
Chimtak khop a sual in leng akangkhem asiang tuan kei a, mei in leng akangsiang sam kei hi.
Na nitna hukna ahi a, ka hon khuah a, na sian tuan louh ziak in na tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak mateng chik mah chiang in na nitna a kipan khuahsiang na hi nawnta kei ding hi.

Kei TOUPA'N ka chita ahi, ahong tung mahmah ding, ke'n ka hih ding, ka nungkin kei ding a, ka hawi sam kei ding a, ka lunghei sam kei ding; na omdante leh na thilhih bang zel in vai ahon hawmsak ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Zawlneipa Zi Sihna

paite: "Mihing tapa, ngai in, thakhat in na mittaina pen ka hon laksak ding a, na suun ding ahi kei dia, na kah ding leng ahi sam kei, na khitui leng akiak ding ahi kei hi.
Asim in thum inla, misi suunna nei ke'n, na dial khim inla, na khedap bun inla, na muk hum ke'nla, mite an leng ne ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in zingsang lam in mipite kiang ah thu ka gen a, nitaklam in ka zi asi maimah a; zingsang lam in ahon thupiak bang in ka hih hi.
Mite'n ka kiang ah, hichibang na thilhihte kou ding in bang ahia ahih na hon hilh kei dia hia? achi uhi.
Huchi in ke'n akiang uah, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a.

Israel inkote kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ka mun siangthou, na hatna suan pen uh, na mittaina pen uh, na deihlam pen uh ka hihnin ding hi; na tanute uh; na tapate uh, nunglam a na nutsiatte uh namsau in apuk ding uh.
Ka hih bang geih in na hih tei ding uhi; na muk uh na hum kei ding ua, mite an leng na ne sam kei ding uh.
Na dialte uh leng na khim ding ua, na khedap uh na bun ding ua; na suun kei ding ua, na kap sam kei ding ua, na thulimlouhnate uah na mangthang ding ua, na kikahtuah ding uhi.
Hichibang in Ezekiel, nou a ding in etsakna ahi ding a, ahihdan bang zel in na hih ding uh ahi; hiai ahong tun hun chiang in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh, chi ahi, ka chi hi.
"Huan nang mihing tapa, amau a kipan ahatnate uh, athupi kipahnate uh, amit tainapente uh, alunglutna pente uh, atanu uleh atapate uh ka lakmang ni chiang in,
huai ni mahmah chiang in na kiang ah taikhemi hong pai in, ahong theisak kei ding ua hia?

Huai ni chiang in taikhemi kiang ah na kam na ka ding a, akiang ah thu na gen ding a, na dai maimah kei ding; huchi in amaute a ding in etsakna na hi ding a; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
